scenes.setting: The doorbell brings Aaron again: a new dream — a peeled birch outside Grimm Cemetery with Will Auceptin sitting quietly beneath it — even though the real paper crane is above the fog; one pound to escort him there, and a bathroom divination says almost no risk

Myriad Star Cathedral: a made-up cautionary tale about a detective's murdered servants explains away the lack of maids; Aaron goes to his confessional while Klein sits in the dark hall of pearls and rubies, oddly tranquil — only his third time inside the Goddess's cathedral
scenes.text_anchor: Come to think of it, this is only my third time entering the Goddess’s cathedral…

scenes.setting: Cathedral of Serenity: officially a Red Glove, Leonard is placed in Soul Assurer Soest's team and handed a devil-summoning case with instructions to weigh Backlund's consecutive incidents and the tarot ritual. 'This will be the beginning of my revenge…'
scenes.text_anchor: “This will be the beginning of my revenge…”

scenes.setting: The woods by Grimm Cemetery: the dreamed birch is found, the ground beneath it dug with borrowed shovels — and out of the soil comes a rotted child's body missing the lower half of its left leg. 'Will Auceptin! Will Auceptin!'
